data.name: Hazard Protocol
data.detailed_description:
ENTER THE QUARANTINE

Hazard Protocol is a 1–4 player top-down cooperative horror shooter built around short, tense missions. Enter abandoned hospitals, research facilities and quarantined city streets as an outbreak-response operative. Complete the objective, keep the squad alive and reach extraction.

FIGHT AS A SQUAD

Stay together, cover different angles and rescue downed teammates before the infected overwhelm your position. Special infected leap, spit acid, ambush and break apart a careless formation. Ammunition, grenades and medical supplies are limited, so every mistake follows the squad into the next room.

OBJECTIVES UNDER PRESSURE

Restoring power is only the beginning. Unlock sealed doors, find access cards, operate keypads, redirect steam and solve environmental mechanisms while the horde closes in. Some objectives split the team; others force everyone to defend the same exposed position.

A DIFFERENT RESPONSE EACH TIME

Encounter pacing adapts to the squad's condition. Enemy pressure rises and falls, selected layouts and routes change, and resources do not always appear in the same place. Four difficulty levels change enemy health and damage without turning the mission into a different game.

BUILD YOUR OPERATIVE

Choose an operative and their default kit, or customize your primary and secondary weapons from unlocked equipment. Earn account XP after every mission, unlock new side-grade weapons and passive perks, and equip up to three small bonuses. Progress expands your options without replacing teamwork or skill.

KEY FEATURES

  • Solo play or 1–4 player online co-op

  • Fixed-perspective top-down tactical gunplay

  • Adaptive wave pacing with swarming and special infected

  • Environmental objectives and puzzles completed under pressure

  • Short 10–30 minute missions with layout and encounter variation

  • Primary and secondary loadouts, operatives, perks and post-match progression

  • Easy, Normal, Hard and Nightmare difficulty

  • Blood, dismemberment and reactive combat feedback

  • Full controller support and cross-platform multiplayer

data.short_description: Race the horde in a 1–4 player top-down co-op horror shooter. Complete objectives, improvise with scarce supplies, rescue downed teammates, and reach extraction through tense 10–30 minute missions whose pressure adapts to your squad.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT 6 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Internet connection is required for online co-op only.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Internet connection is required for online co-op only.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains intense combat against zombie-like infected, blood, gore, dismemberment and decapitation. Human player characters and infected may die violently. The game includes fictional medical drugs and online player interaction, including session chat.
